# spatial-primitives.types: RoundedBox3D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A box with edges and corners rounded by CornerRadius: the Minkowski sum of a
> shrunken box and a ball. CornerRadius is clamped to half the smallest extent.
> (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minkowski\_addition)
